facts.fact: ANIP says Benin adopted a law in 2017 on the identification of natural persons.
facts.system: Loi de 2017 relative à l'identification des personnes physiques

facts.fact: ANIP says the 2017 law set up a unique identifier, the NPI, issued at enrolment in the RNPP, which holds biometrics, and now required on personal administrative acts.
facts.system: Loi de 2017 relative à l'identification des personnes physiques
